pages.text: Right-click the face of a block to record it. The tool remembers the position and the side, and shows them in its tooltip.$(br2)Then open a filter rule and click its destination slot while holding the tool. Whatever that rule matches will go to that face and nowhere else.

One tool can be re-pointed as many times as you like; recording a new face simply replaces the old one.$(br2)Clicking the destination slot with an empty hand clears the pin, and the rule goes back to sending its matches wherever the network wants them.
